patterns.message: @zenbu/ui runs in the website and in the browser extension, so it imports no Next.js, theme switcher, or client code (docs/agents/ui.md, What the package may import). Take a link as a render prop, an action as a callback, and text as a prop, and let each client pass its own.
@zenbu/ui draws the core's answers and never runs a lookup, so it imports only the core's detail/* modules (docs/agents/ui.md, What the package may import). Take what a lookup returns as a prop.

deniedGlobals.fetch: @zenbu/ui reads no data itself: take an action such as loadMore(from) or loadFormExamples(surface), and let the client fetch (docs/agents/ui.md, What the package may import).
deniedGlobals.XMLHttpRequest: @zenbu/ui reads no data itself: take an action such as loadMore(from) or loadFormExamples(surface), and let the client fetch (docs/agents/ui.md, What the package may import).
deniedGlobals.localStorage: @zenbu/ui keeps nothing: take the value as a prop and a change as a callback, and let the client store it (docs/agents/ui.md, What the package may import).
deniedGlobals.chrome: @zenbu/ui calls no extension API: take an action as a callback, and let the extension call Chrome (docs/agents/ui.md, What the package may import).
deniedGlobals.console: @zenbu/ui logs nothing: take a callback such as onUnsupported, and let the client report it (docs/agents/ui.md, What the package may import).
